development_cohort: rc2 original59; held-out repository identities are disjoint
eligibility: public, not archived, at least100 stars, SPDX3.29.0 isOsiApproved flag true
path_frame: all tracked .py paths under repository root excluding test/tests/docs/doc/vendor/vendored/generated/.venv/site-packages components
candidate_predicate: AST imports StateGraph from langgraph.graph (aliases included), or literal StateGraph call; alias/module-qualified calls resolved only syntactically by import bindings
holdout_handling: Freeze source identities, hashes and all candidate bytes before frontend edits. Frontend implementation agent must not inspect held-out source; evaluator scores unchanged files after declared implementation freeze. One final hold-out evaluation; after inspection, any changes are documented as development and require a fresh future hold-out to generalize.
outcomes: whole-file admitted under explicit module/API premises
explicit supported workflow slice (reported separately, never whole-file admission)
differential_requirement: Whole-source or explicitly scoped callable executes with actual pinned LangGraph and deterministic shared response oracle. Compare canonical complete model invocation arguments, returned response values, final selected graph state and usage/status sequence; fixtures or synthetic source rewrites never count as external.
contracts: Explicit source-authentic provider/model/call configuration where statically available, otherwise separately declared conditional model premises. Missing source values cannot be synthesized and attributed to original source.
bounds: No arbitrary source execution, paid API calls, network credentials or import side effects during selection. All unsupported candidates and unsuccessful differentials remain in denominators.
inference_limits: Convenience sample, repository/file denominators distinct; no population rate, novelty or translation-correctness conclusion from admissions alone.

retrieval_caps.oversize_and_retrieval_errors: retained as explicit failure records; no silent denominator removal
